001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.CurrentBatteryV2Response;
007
008/**
009 * One step of a multi-record battery procedure, written on both the Mobi and the t:slim X2 at no
010 * fixed time of day. A sequence starts with {@link #getUnknown10()} = 1 and ends with 0, about 30
011 * seconds per step. Some sequences end after the first step; others run three 1, 2, 3 cycles
012 * first. In the 3 sequences with live battery traffic where the value changed, the final record's
013 * {@link #getCurrentBatteryAbc()} equalled {@link #getUnknown13()} of the earlier records, and the
014 * next {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response} reported that new value as currentBatteryAbc. So this looks
015 * like a re-estimate of the battery's state of charge; that reading is an inference.
016 *
017 * The class name is provisional: opcode 330 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
018 * app's history log list. Fields not named here have not been identified and are exposed raw.
019 */
020@HistoryLogProps(
021    opCode = 330,
022    displayName = "Battery Estimate Update"
023)
024public class BatteryEstimateUpdateHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
025
026    private int unknown10;
027    private int unknown11;
028    private int currentBatteryAbc;
029    private int unknown13;
030    private int unknown14;
031    private int lipoMv;
032    private int currentBatteryIbc;
033    private long elapsedMs;
034
035    public BatteryEstimateUpdateHistoryLog() {}
036    public BatteryEstimateUpdateHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int unknown10, int unknown11, int currentBatteryAbc, int unknown13, int unknown14, int lipoMv, int currentBatteryIbc, long elapsedMs) {
037        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
038        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, unknown10, unknown11, currentBatteryAbc, unknown13, unknown14, lipoMv, currentBatteryIbc, elapsedMs);
039        this.unknown10 = unknown10;
040        this.unknown11 = unknown11;
041        this.currentBatteryAbc = currentBatteryAbc;
042        this.unknown13 = unknown13;
043        this.unknown14 = unknown14;
044        this.lipoMv = lipoMv;
045        this.currentBatteryIbc = currentBatteryIbc;
046        this.elapsedMs = elapsedMs;
047    }
048
049    public int typeId() {
050        return 330;
051    }
052
053    /**
054     * <table border="1">
055     * <caption>Parsed fields for BatteryEstimateUpdateHistoryLog:</caption>
056     * <tr><td><code>unknown10</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>unknown11</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>currentBatteryAbc</code></td><td><code>raw[12] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>unknown13</code></td><td><code>raw[13] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>unknown14</code></td><td><code>(short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>lipoMv</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>currentBatteryIbc</code></td><td><code>raw[18] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>elapsedMs</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
064     * </table>
065     */
066    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
067        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
068        this.cargo = raw;
069        parseBase(raw);
070        this.unknown10 = raw[10] & 0xFF;
071        this.unknown11 = raw[11] & 0xFF;
072        this.currentBatteryAbc = raw[12] & 0xFF;
073        this.unknown13 = raw[13] & 0xFF;
074        this.unknown14 = (short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
075        this.lipoMv = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
076        this.currentBatteryIbc = raw[18] & 0xFF;
077        this.elapsedMs = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
078    }
079
080    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int unknown10, int unknown11, int currentBatteryAbc, int unknown13, int unknown14, int lipoMv, int currentBatteryIbc, long elapsedMs) {
081        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
082            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(330, 0),
083            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
084            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
085            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(unknown10),
086            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(unknown11),
087            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(currentBatteryAbc),
088            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(unknown13),
089            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown14),
090            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(lipoMv),
091            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(currentBatteryIbc),
092            new byte[3],
093            Bytes.toUint32(elapsedMs)));
094    }
095
096    /**
097     * Step within the sequence: 1, 2, 3 (occasionally 4) while it runs, 0 in its final record.
098     *
099     * @return raw uint8 at offset 10
100     */
101    public int getUnknown10() {
102        return unknown10;
103    }
104
105    /**
106     * 1 only in records where {@link #getUnknown10()} is 3, else 0.
107     *
108     * @return raw uint8 at offset 11
109     */
110    public int getUnknown11() {
111        return unknown11;
112    }
113
114    /**
115     * Equal to {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getCurrentBatteryAbc()} before the sequence; in the
116     * final record, the value the pump reports afterwards.
117     *
118     * @return battery percent, 0-100
119     */
120    public int getCurrentBatteryAbc() {
121        return currentBatteryAbc;
122    }
123
124    /**
125     * Often above 100 in the first record of a sequence (always 136 on the Mobi); in later
126     * records, the value {@link #getCurrentBatteryAbc()} takes in the final record.
127     *
128     * @return raw uint8 at offset 13
129     */
130    public int getUnknown13() {
131        return unknown13;
132    }
133
134    /**
135     * Signed; -38 to 213 observed.
136     *
137     * @return raw int16 at offset 14
138     */
139    public int getUnknown14() {
140        return unknown14;
141    }
142
143    /**
144     * Close to {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getUnknown3()} read around the same time.
145     *
146     * @return battery voltage in millivolts
147     */
148    public int getLipoMv() {
149        return lipoMv;
150    }
151
152    /**
153     * @return {@link CurrentBatteryV2Response#getCurrentBatteryIbc()} before the sequence
154     */
155    public int getCurrentBatteryIbc() {
156        return currentBatteryIbc;
157    }
158
159    /**
160     * Milliseconds since the first record of the sequence (exactly 30000, 60000, 62000, ... on the
161     * t:slim X2, about 30300 per 30-second step on the Mobi); 0 in the final record.
162     *
163     * @return elapsed time in milliseconds
164     */
165    public long getElapsedMs() {
166        return elapsedMs;
167    }
168}
